`enum VertexAttribute`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.vertex` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VertexAttribute.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/vertex/VertexAttribute.java)

The attributes of a JOID vertex, each with its shader input, its location, its byte offset and its format.

## Description

A backend declares its vertex input from these values: one binding of `VertexBuffer.STRIDE` bytes, one attribute per constant.
[`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) writes the same locations with `layout(location = n)` for a dialect with explicit locations; for the other dialects, the backend binds them when it links the program.
